title: Get a permit for an advertising sign in a public place
what: Get the council's permit before putting an advertising sign or bill on a road, footpath, council property or other public place.

laws.title: Town of Vincent Trading in Public Places Local Law 2008

sources.title: Town of Vincent Trading in Public Places Local Law 2008
sources.locator: cl 2.24(1), as made, Gazette No. 58, 15 Apr 2008
sources.quote: A person shall not display an advertising sign on a footpath unless that person is the holder of a valid sign permit.

sources.title: Town of Vincent Trading in Public Places Local Law 2008
sources.locator: cl 2.27, as made, Gazette No. 58, 15 Apr 2008
sources.quote: A person shall not cause or permit an advertising signto be erected or displayed in such a condition, which in the opinion of an authorised person, causes or is likely to cause injury or danger to any person or damage to the clothing or possessions of any person.
